name: Kitty Love
source:
Beau, a gay catboy, is trying to date two boys at once. He really screws it up with both of them when he runs into the two of them in the same coffee shop! Can Beau earn back the love of Shane or Colt, or will he die forever alone?

[Edited from [url=http://rosstin.wordpress.com/2012/03/17/kitty-love-3/]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
博是一只同性恋猫耳少年，他试图同时和两个男孩约会。当他在同一家咖啡店偶遇两人时，事情彻底搞砸了！博能否赢回谢恩或柯尔特的爱，还是将孤独终老？

[编辑自[url=http://rosstin.wordpress.com/2012/03/17/kitty-love-3/]官方网站[/url]]
